Let me extend the trail to the Red block and seal it with ACTION7. Then I'll check if the sealed trail stays in place when I move the player DOWN.
Actually, let me think about this differently. What if the goal is to "paint" the blocks by having the trail touch them? Like, the trail needs to touch all three blocks simultaneously?
But the trail is horizontal, so it can only touch one block at a time (unless the trail is very long and spans multiple vertical positions, which it doesn't seem to).
Wait, what if I can create multiple trail segments at different vertical positions? Like, extend the trail, move UP/DOWN to create a new segment, extend again, etc.?
Actually, looking at the animation data from the UP action, it shows 144 cells changed with 2 large objects moving. This suggests the ENTIRE trail moved up with the player. So there's only one trail, and it moves with the player.
Let me just extend the trail to the Red block and seal it, then see what happens.
